author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Modos has launched the Crowd Supply campaign for the Flow, a 13.3-inch e-paper monitor designed for reading, writing, browsing, and other document-focused workflows. The display uses E Ink technology and is offered in monochrome and color variants, with touch support, USB Type-C connectivity, and an open-hardware design. title: Modos Flow is a paper-like 13.3-inch monitor with 60 Hz refresh and touch support
